literal: * C_ReportSystem.InitiateReportPlayer() and C_ReportSystem.SendReportPlayer() were protected to prevent automating reports, addons have to use C_ReportSystem.OpenReportPlayerDialog() now. TSquare 2019-04-24. IRC #wowuidev
